description: This file defines the trait DataSourceV2ScanExecBase and related classes for executing data source scans in Spark SQL, including partitioning, metrics, and columnar support.

classes.name: DataSourceV2ScanExecBase
classes.description: Trait for executing data source scans with support for partitioning, metrics, and columnar processing.

classes.name: KeyGroupedPartition
classes.description: Represents a Spark partition consisting of multiple input splits sharing a common key.

classes.name: KeyGroupedPartitionInfo
classes.description: Contains information about grouped partitions and their original input partitions.

methods.name: groupPartitions
methods.description: Groups input partitions based on partition keys if bucketing is enabled and all partitions support partition keys.

methods.name: supportsColumnar
methods.description: Determines if the scan supports columnar execution based on the scan's columnar support mode.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Executes the scan and returns an RDD of InternalRow, with metrics collection.

methods.name: doExecuteColumnar
methods.description: Executes the scan in columnar mode, returning an RDD of ColumnarBatch.
